events: António de Abreu discovers Timor Island, and reaches the Banda Islands, Ambon Island and Seram.
Francisco Serrao and other shipwreck sailors with permission from the Ternate Sultanate build Fort Tolukko.
The Portuguese are the first Europeans to land in Timor island, as the first settlers arrive to the north…
The Portuguese ally with the Sultanate of Ternate and begin the construction of Fort Kastela.
The Portuguese, allied with King Ilato of the Goratalo kingdom, construct the Otanaha Fortress.
